Table A-1: Employment status of the civilian population by sex and age
Selected group: TOTAL; civilian noninstitutional population age 16 and over
Geography: United States (50 states and District of Columbia)
Level unit: thousands of persons; unemployment rate: percent

The full Table A-1 header was inspected. Its columns run:
NSA July 2023; NSA June 2024; NSA July 2024; SA July 2023;
SA March 2024; SA April 2024; SA May 2024; SA June 2024; SA July 2024.
The six selected columns below are original positions 1,2,3,4,8,9.
NSA = not seasonally adjusted. SA = seasonally adjusted.
The civilian population itself is not seasonally adjusted; its identical
values appear in both sets of source columns (Table A-1 footnote 1).
Commas used as source thousands separators are removed in the data block.
The rates retain the source's one decimal place. No numbers were imputed.

Target facts independently read in the release's Household Survey Data text:
July 2024 SA unemployment rate: 4.3 percent.
June-to-July 2024 SA rate change: +0.2 percentage point.
June-to-July 2024 SA unemployed level change: +352 thousand persons.
July 2024 SA unemployed level in narrative display: 7.2 million persons.
July 2023 SA unemployment rate: 3.5 percent.

This is a small extract of actual published survey estimates, not synthetic
worker observations. BLS microdata weighting, population controls, seasonal
adjustment estimation and sampling variances are not reproduced by this file.
The source table notes annual updated population controls; the release's
technical note describes seasonal adjustment, revisions and survey error.
